summary: Verified the git-configuration bug fix for missing .env.example files. All git checks pass: only backend/.env.example and frontend/.env.example are tracked (no real .env files), .gitignore correctly ignores .env/.env.*/*.env but the negation !.env.example works, and no real EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY (ek_dabc...) or other secrets present in git history. Fresh clone at /tmp/shree-clone-test succeeded, both .env.example files were present, `cp` steps from scripts/run-local.sh worked and produced correct content (empty EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY in backend/.env, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 in frontend/.env). scripts/run-local.sh passes `bash -n` syntax check. Live backend at preview URL responds 200 with {status:ok} without MongoDB. UI regression smoke: dashboard renders cleanly, Create Invoice tab loads, invoice SHPG-2026-0001 generated successfully with success panel and no pageerrors. /tmp/shree-clone-test cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: One invoice SHPG-2026-0001 generated during UI regression smoke via LocalStorage/preview app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix (env.example templates + gitignore negation) is verified end-to-end. mongod is intentionally stopped in this pod and backend works without it (uses in-browser storage / no DB writes for /api/ health). Real EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY stays in untracked /app/backend/.env only.
rca of the issue: Original bug: .gitignore ignored `.env` and `.env.*` globs which also swallowed `.env.example`, so fresh clones lacked templates and scripts/run-local.sh failed on `cp backend/.env.example backend/.env`. Fix in commit 2848fae added a `!.env.example` negation after the ignore rules and committed both example files with safe empty values. Verified via git ls-tree, git check-ignore, git grep for secrets, and a fresh clone dry-run.
